title: Core System Administration: Permissions, systemd, and Packages
description: Take over a small analytics host. Close a world writable log, fix a shared directory that keeps losing its group, grant one engineer read access without handing over the group, repair a systemd unit that fails with 203/EXEC, and pin a package so an upgrade cannot move it.

steps.title: Grant one person access, not a group
Repair a service that will not start
Find the owner, then hold it still
